script.title: Renge-in — Japanese Buddhist Temple of the Golden Lotus
script.description: Pure Land (Jodo) Buddhist temple sanctuary featuring a two-tiered Irimoya Main Hall (Hondo) housing an Amida Triad (Great Golden Buddha and Bodhisattva attendants on a lotus throne), a Three-Storey Pagoda (Sanju-no-to), a Shoro Bell Pavilion with hanging bronze Bonsho bell, a Sacred Lotus & Koi Pond spanned by an arched vermilion Taikobashi bridge, flanking Niomon Guardian gatehouses, a Chozuya purification pavilion, Jokoro incense cauldron, sculpted Sakura and Momiji trees, and a rear Karesansui Zen rock garden.
